## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. English or Türkçe is welcome.

## Validation

List the relevant checks you actually ran and their results. Identify simulated, synthetic and live evidence separately. Explain any unverified behavior.

## Review notes

Call out consent, access, budgets, model licensing or setup implications when applicable. Include a synthetic-data screenshot for UI changes. Never attach credentials, runtime data or private conversations.
